newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen testing upside, volume key.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen testing upside, volume key.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures were seen testing the upside again after three consecutive days of encouraging closes.
July was called to open up 10 stg to add to Wednesday's rise.
A late rally pushed July up to close at 1,025 stg per tonne, just one stg off its session high on Wednesday and the highest level since June 2.
CSCE July also closed strongly, gaining $36 to $1,471, to reach the highest level since May 29. New York's gains were also made amid heavy volume, estimated at 12,798 lots.

"Since March, (London July) cocoa has been in a flag chart," said Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures. "Now, it needs to break 1,040 to break out of the flag. If it breaks 1,040, we could see 1,160."

Though flag formations usually have a better chance of breaking out to the upside (a two-thirds chance versus one-third for a break down), Neil warned that triple resistance loomed above between 1,040 and 1,060. He said peaks have been made within that range in March, April and most recently, two weeks ago.
As a result, he said volume would probably be the first indicator of whether cocoa will have the strength this time to break out this time.
"High volume days as we approach the breakout point builds energy, and that would mean it would be more likely to breakout," he said.
If July cocoa failed on the upside again, the contract could fall again to test a triple bottom at the April 9 low of 980. Since April, 980 has also tested and held on May 1 and June 5.
If 980 broke, Neil said he could see a swift move to next support at 910. Below that, critical support rested at 875, he said.
